== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Naraka, also known as the Cavern of Flame, is a [[Territory]] characterized by extreme heat, darkness, and an acrid stench. The environment is composed of massive caverns filled with smoke and intense temperatures that can be lethal to those unprepared. To survive the heat, initiates undergo a [[ritual]] involving the consumption of fruit from an [[obsidian tree]], which provides varying degrees of thermal protection. [[Travelers]] of this realm are expected to be driven by a compulsion toward law, order, and the enforcement of moral principles. This sense of justice is central to the identity of its people, including groups like the [[Gar'rosh]] who use the [[Territory]] to punish criminals. The realm is overseen by a Grandmaster, such as the scarred and clawed woman who wears traditional dark red robes. [[The Territory]] is also home to an [[Incarnation]], a powerful entity with a physical form composed of volcanic [[stone]] and ash, featuring eyes that glow like smoldering coals and hair made of flame. While Incarnation{{!}}the Incarnation represents justice, it is described as a force that can be devoid of mercy or conscience. Additionally, the realm contains specific locations like the [[Blue District]] and various waystations, with access managed through Naraka [[Gates]] that can only be opened at particular points.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Naraka is a territory belonging to [[Grandmaster Naraka]] that serves as a source for ferocious creatures and contains numerous black pits. This realm can be traveled through via specific waypoints used for fast travel, and it is also associated with a stripe of [[Travelers]] who wear burnt red robes. Within this location, one can pull power from the environment, which features red stones covered in a gritty coating similar to fine ash. Additionally, Naraka functions as a group that provides reinforcements.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Naraka is a blond [[Damascan Traveler]] known as the Cavern of Flame who represents both justice and law and order. As a figure capable of summoning fire from the [[Furnace of Judgment]], she was among the [[Travelers]] who attacked [[Simon]]'s parents. Often seen wearing red-tinted glasses, she is also a location and a [[Territory]] from which incursions may arise. This place contains flaming black lizard-things and is a destination [[Simon]] intends to never visit again.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Naraka is one of the nine Territories and a location that the group has previously traveled through. This realm can be entered via a [[red Gate]], and it is home to a pack of dogs. Within this territory, [[Grandmaster Naraka]] wears traditional dark red robes and possesses knowledge regarding what patrols the streets between sundown and sunup. As a deity or force that can be invoked, Naraka is destined to [[judge]] and punish, though the entity remained unseen by [[Alin]] for an entire day. During certain events, [[Indirial]] was ordered to enter the territory, while an [[old woman]] and several guards remained there.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Then we must act now. If we Travel through Naraka, surely we can make it.”<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“No, just regular Travelers. One of them was Naraka, I think, and the other one summoned this glowing mist.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|shrugged the shoulder without a bird on it, seemingly as lost as Leah felt. “You should visit the Corvinus tribe in Avernus. I suspect you'd find it worthwhile. That's all he said, and may Naraka take me if I know why.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|“Into Naraka,” Indirial ordered, not turning from the door.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|“Do we have to go through Naraka again?” Simon asked.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25" />}}
